goals.title: Strengthen voice interruption invariants
goals.goal: Improve internal voice-runtime interruption and race safety. Verify cancellation state, stale result suppression and non-regression of LISTENING and WORKING. Do not claim real model/TTS cancellation unless backed by a real provider adapter. Preserve audio ownership.

goals.title: Strengthen conversation interruption continuity
goals.goal: Improve bounded communication-state handling for interruptions and resumed turns, with deterministic regression tests. Do not change user data storage, device permissions, routing, security or microphone ownership.
